# OSS Compliance Tooling

> A comprehensive resource for open source software compliance tooling, standards, and best practices powered by the OpenChain Project.

This site provides guidance on OSS compliance landscapes, toolchain elements (including SPDX and OSADL standards), and user stories across multiple compliance roles. It serves as a central hub for organizations implementing automated compliance workflows and container-based development practices.

## Key Topics

- OSS Compliance
- License Compliance
- SPDX
- OpenChain Project
- Software Supply Chain
- SBOM (Software Bill of Materials)
- FOSSology
- ScanCode
- ORT (OSS Review Toolkit)
- ClearlyDefined
- Docker Containers
- Compliance Automation
- Component Management
- License Management
- Open Source Compliance

## Getting Started

- [Overview - sharing-creates-value](https://oss-compliance-tooling.org): Homepage introducing OSS compliance tooling, products, and OpenChain Project
- [Tooling Landscape Overview](https://oss-compliance-tooling.org/Tooling-Landscape): Overview of OSS compliance tooling landscape and CI/CD integration

## Compliance Tools & Standards

- [OSS-Based License Compliance Tools](https://oss-compliance-tooling.org/Tooling-Landscape/OSS-Based-License-Compliance-Tools): Reference guide to existing OSS license compliance tools and AboutCode Toolkit
- [Toolchain Elements Description](https://oss-compliance-tooling.org/Tooling-Landscape/Toolchain-description): Technical reference for compliance toolchain elements including SPDX and OSADL

## User Stories & Roles

- [User Stories Overview](https://oss-compliance-tooling.org/User-Stories): User stories and role models for compliance managers, developers, and PMs
- [Compliance Assistant Epic](https://oss-compliance-tooling.org/User-Stories/Compliance-Assistant-Epic): User story epic for compliance assistant role in license clearing and management
- [Legal Assessor Epic](https://oss-compliance-tooling.org/User-Stories/Legal-Assessor-Epic): User story epic for legal assessor evaluating OSS license risks and compliance
- [Software Developer Epic](https://oss-compliance-tooling.org/User-Stories/Software-Developer-Epic): User story epic for developers managing OSS components and bill of materials
- [Software Architect Epic](https://oss-compliance-tooling.org/User-Stories/Software-Architect-Epic): User story epic for architects tracking OSS dependencies and license compliance
- [ECC Expert Epic](https://oss-compliance-tooling.org/User-Stories/ECC-Expert-Epic): User story epic for ECC expert handling export control and OSS compliance

## Container Compliance

- [Container Definitions](https://oss-compliance-tooling.org/Containers/Definitions): Guide to container definitions, Docker terminology, and Dockerfile compliance
- [Container Best Practices](https://oss-compliance-tooling.org/Containers/Best-Practices): Best practices for Docker container compliance and security with REUSE standard

## Community & Support

- [Contact](https://oss-compliance-tooling.org/contact): Contact information for OpenChain Reference Tooling Work Group and community
